company.name: ZeroDown
company.shortDescription: ZeroDown is a real estate startup that focuses on providing an affordable homeownership solution.
company.description:
ZeroDown is a real estate startup that focuses on providing an affordable homeownership solution. It is an alternative to the rent-or-own dilemma, offering the benefits of homeownership with the flexibility of renting.

It was founded in 2018 by Abhijeet Dwivedi (Previously COO and CSO at Zenefits, McKinsey), Hari Viswanathan (Previously Staff Engineer at Zenefits) and Laks Srini (Previously Co-founder and CTO at Zenefits, SigFig and D. E. Shaw & Co). The three founders worked together at Zenefits -- which processes $2B+ a year in payroll for SMBs, provides access to healthcare and insurance for 100,000+ employees and serves more than 10,000 SMBs.

productsAndServices.description: ZeroDown's rent-to-own program allows customers to live in a home they plan to buy, making monthly payments that contribute towards the purchase without a large initial down payment.
productsAndServices.name: Rent-to-Own Program

productsAndServices.description: ZeroDown offers an advanced home search feature, including a Home Quiz that matches users with homes based on their preferences, providing a compatibility score for each listing.
productsAndServices.name: Home Search and Matching

productsAndServices.description: During the lease period of the rent-to-own program, ZeroDown handles maintenance and repairs to keep the home safe and habitable, also covering common repairs with a home warranty.
productsAndServices.name: Home Maintenance and Repairs

productsAndServices.description: Renters in the rent-to-own program can personalize their living space with permissible renovations, as outlined in ZeroDown's guidelines, making the house feel more like a home before purchase.
productsAndServices.name: Home Customization Options
